entry.title: New: dsh-drawio
entry.summary: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws. Exact install spec: dsh-drawio. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
